findings.evidence: Trace.lean:322-326 vs SturmBound.lean:61-66; the shared inputs are declared in Cusps.lean:148 (`Subgroup.integerCuspWidth_pos`) and Cusps.lean:156 (`Subgroup.integerCuspWidth_mem_strictPeriods`), and mathlib/Mathlib/NumberTheory/ModularForms/Cusps.lean:407 (`isCusp_of_mem_strictPeriods`). Cusps.lean is imported by Trace.lean:8 and transitively by SturmBound.lean:9. Only one call site remains for the private helper (SturmBound.lean:79).
findings.fix: Add `lemma Subgroup.isCusp_infty_of_isFiniteRelIndex : IsCusp OnePoint.infty 𝒢 := Subgroup.isCusp_of_mem_strictPeriods (by exact_mod_cast Subgroup.integerCuspWidth_pos) Subgroup.integerCuspWidth_mem_strictPeriods` to `TauCeti/NumberTheory/ModularForms/Cusps.lean` (inside the `[𝒢.IsFiniteRelIndex 𝒮ℒ]` section, next to `integerCuspWidth_pos` at line 148). Both sites then reduce to one line: `OnePoint.isBoundedAt_infty_iff.mp (ModularFormClass.bdd_at_cusps f Subgroup.isCusp_infty_of_isFiniteRelIndex)` and likewise with `f.bdd_at_cusps'`. This dodges the section-variable objection raised in the earlier round, since the statement mentions only `𝒢` — no `f : F`, no `ModularFormClass` variable.
findings.issue: `hf_bdd` (Trace.lean:322-326) and `isBoundedAtImInfty_of_finiteRelIndex` (SturmBound.lean:61-66) are the same three-step derivation written twice: cast `integerCuspWidth_pos` to `ℝ`, feed it plus `integerCuspWidth_mem_strictPeriods` to `isCusp_of_mem_strictPeriods`, then `bdd_at_cusps`/`bdd_at_cusps'` and `isBoundedAt_infty_iff.mp`. Before this PR the reasoning appeared once; the PR description claims it was extracted to a helper, but the helper now has a single call site (SturmBound.lean:79) and factors nothing.

summary: The new identity's proof is well-structured and adequately commented, but the PR increases duplication rather than removing it: the cusp/boundedness derivation is now performed verbatim in two files instead of once. Factor the group-only `IsCusp OnePoint.infty 𝒢` step into `Cusps.lean`.
